rows.label: Births that never happen per year of modern contraception (GiveWell)

source.title: GiveWell, Valuing contraception, 'Model' tab: number of unwanted births averted per year of modern contraception

rows.explainer: Of the 0.3 unintended pregnancies a year of contraception averts (GiveWell's 0.2 to 0.4), 49% would end in a birth and a third of those births are unwanted rather than mistimed: 0.049 births that never happen. The 0.099 mistimed births a year happen later, so they are not lives that never start. Range: GiveWell's 0.2 to 0.4 pregnancies.
